name: Vaelastrasz the Corrupt
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/blackwing-lair/vaelastrasz.md. Era 40-man: he starts at 30% of 3,331,000 HP (about 1,000,000 effective); the fight is a single 165 s burn from 30% to 0 (a real kill is around 2:45, soft-enraged by Essence of the Red at 3:00; the pre-pull dialogue of about 43.5 s is not simulated). He is immune to Taunt: the button is relabelled Step in and stands for the next tank in the queue taking him with Sunders. Essence of the Red (180 s, +500 mana, 50 energy, 20 rage per second) is the reason this script's numbers look large: every tank-side number has been tuned for unlimited resources. The healer heal is 3500 on the same GCD and the passive tank healing is high (1400/s on the ghost when nobody plays healer, 500/s with a healer player, 1300/s on a player tank); without unlimited mana these numbers would be fiction, and a healer who stops pressing buttons still loses the tank in under 20 s. The 3:00 enrage itself is not modelled because the phase ends at 165 s. Burning Adrenaline (random) is a carried bomb: 20 s in the real fight (kills the carrier, 4376-5001 Fire to allies within about 10 yd). Engine: `carried` hazard, radius 10, 14 s fuse (shorter than the real 20 s so the run-out is rehearsed before the bot would die), 1500 damage on the carrier so the rehearsal does not count a death. Real -5% max HP per second, +100% damage and the Ice Block rule cannot be expressed. `playerChance` 0.25 instead of the fair 1/40 so you actually practise it. Cadence: every 16 s (first at 16 s; research: 15 s to 17.8 s from logs). `roles: [ranged, healer]`: in the real fight it only goes on classes with mana (Warcraft Tavern, Warcraft Wiki), so warriors and rogues in the melee seat never get it unless they are top of his threat list. Burning Adrenaline (tank): every 45 s, first at 45 s, a `debuff` on the tank (`tankAdrenaline`, 20 s, no damage). He stays on that tank until it dies, and `follow` fires `tankSwap` (`targetSwitch` onto the raid) 18 s later: that is the moment the old tank drops and the next tank has to take him (a player tank presses Step in; the ghost tank comes back after 2.5 s). The fuse is the point: the next tank spends those seconds building threat (Warcraft Wiki, Wowhead, Warcraft Tavern; cmangos casts it on the victim with no special handling). This models the swap, not the real tank line of 4-5 warriors or the death of the outgoing tank: a player tank is its own next tank, and the hits-twice-as-hard part of the debuff cannot be expressed. Flame Breath: 2 s cast, frontal cone 45 yd (classicdb), first at 11 s then every 4-8 s (cmangos), real 3500-4500 + 938-1063 every 3 s for 15 s. Scaled to 3000 + 350/s for 10 s (refreshed by every breath, so the debuff is permanent on the tank). Fire Nova: 600 every 5 s (555-645). Cleave every 15 s (cmangos). Flame Breath is only cast while he is on the tank and not freshly Taunted (`conditional: onPlayer`), so a swap cannot point a breath at the raid in this model (the real risk of a breath on the raid at a swap is why tips say never to turn him). Tail Sweep every 20 s, 30 yd rear cone (90 degrees here; the true width is unknown), `conditional: behind` (only when someone stands there). Layout note: the Warcraft Wiki has tanks on his left and casters against the wall on his right; this rehearsal mirrors that (warrior line at his right shoulder on the north side, casters mid-room on his left), because a caster spot on the north wall leaves a Burning Adrenaline carrier nowhere to run except through his breath cone. He is `stationary`: he is never moved in the real fight, so the rehearsal cannot drag him onto the raid. Damage is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives on passive healing but a healer who ignores a breath loses the tank: melee 600 per 2 s plus the numbers above. Aggro pulls every ~50 s stand in for the DPS outrunning a freshly swapped tank. Boss melee is a placeholder scaled to the 10,000 HP model. Engine gaps: no resources (Essence of the Red is a tuning decision, not a mechanic); no resistance gear; no stacking or %-max-HP damage; no separate tank line; no Vanish or Feign Death to dump threat at a swap; no dialogue before the pull. Debuffs on others are only dispelled when the player is the healer, and nothing here is dispellable. Fidelity correction: normal encounter schedules no longer inject artificial DPS aggro pulls; threat changes through combat and actual encounter mechanics. Dedicated aggro drills retain their explicit stress events. Fidelity correction: Threat burst now adds a fixed amount of threat in melee range. It no longer copies the top threat or forces a target. The automated raid holds damage while a tank recovers aggro. Fidelity correction: the grounded boss follows its target. It is no longer permanently rooted to make the practice easier; ordinary cast windows still stop movement.

labels.text: Warrior line at his right shoulder
Casters: mid-room, opposite the tank line

tankSpot.label: Tank: hold his head toward the west wall

rangedSpot.label: Ranged: mid-room, opposite the tank line

healerSpot.label: Healers: with the casters, in reach of the tank

boss.looseHint: Build threat in melee range. This boss cannot be taunted.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold him with his head to the wall so the breath goes nowhere. Every 45 s Burning Adrenaline lands on the tank and he stays on them until they die. In this rehearsal you are the whole queue: build threat while the debuff runs; he turns when the old tank dies, about 18 s later, and you step in at that moment.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stay on his side, between front and rear legs, clear of breath and tail. Never stand directly behind him. Warriors and rogues never get Burning Adrenaline unless they are top of his threat list. If you are a mana melee (Retribution, Enhancement), run it out.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stand mid-room opposite the tank line, away from breath and tail. If you get Burning Adrenaline, run out and spam instants from alone. Stop attacking if the bar goes red.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Essence of the Red removes the mana limit, so this is pure throughput. A breath every 4-8 s lands on the tank and each one must be followed by a big heal, or the tank dies.

taunt.label: Threat burst
taunt.tip: Build threat with melee attacks. This practice button combines several attacks; it cannot taunt or guarantee that the boss switches to you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A huge heal, because the Essence of the Red removes mana as a limit. Land it after every breath.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Nothing on this fight is dispellable. The button is here only because the common kit has it.

burningAdrenaline.label: Burning Adrenaline
burningAdrenaline.tip: On a random raid member. +100% damage, all spells instant, and at the end you explode for 4400-5000 Fire. Run out of the raid straight away, spam instants, die alone.

bombOnYou.label: Burning Adrenaline
bombOnYou.tip: Drill version: every Burning Adrenaline lands on you. Run it out, spam instants, go off alone.

tankAdrenaline.label: Burning Adrenaline (tank)
tankAdrenaline.tip: Every 45 s the tank on top of his list gets Burning Adrenaline and dies about 18-20 s later, hitting twice as hard until then. He stays on that tank. The next tank spends those seconds building threat and must be on him the moment the old tank drops.

tankSwap.label: Tank down: next tank in
tankSwap.toast: The old tank has dropped. Next tank, take him now!
tankSwap.tip: Burning Adrenaline has killed the tank. The next tank on the threat list takes him.

flameBreath.label: Flame Breath
flameBreath.tip: A 2 s cast, 3000 Fire plus a heavy burn, every 4 to 8 seconds. Only the tank is ever in front, and the tank line stays out of the cone.

breathDot.label: Flame Breath burn
breathDot.tip: The burn from Flame Breath, refreshed by every breath.

cleave.label: Cleave
cleave.tip: He cleaves the front 90 degrees. Tanks only.

tailSweep.label: Tail Sweep
tailSweep.tip: A 30 yd cone behind him and a long throw. Nobody stands behind Vaelastrasz.

fireNova.label: Fire Nova
fireNova.tip: 555-645 Fire to the whole room every 5 seconds. Fire resistance halves it.

aggroPull.label: Aggro pull
aggroPull.tip: A caster with +100% damage or a DPS with Essence of the Red overtakes the new tank.

phases.name: The Burn
phases.subtitle: From 30% to dead before the Essence fades

expectations.label: Pick him up the moment he turns hostile
expectations.tip: Step in as he ends his dialogue and face his head at the west wall. The breath goes nowhere and the raid stands to his side.

expectations.label: Step in the moment the old tank dies
expectations.tip: Burning Adrenaline kills the tank about 18 seconds after it lands. Build threat during the fuse, then take him the moment he turns. Late is a dead tank and a breath on the raid.

expectations.label: Take him back when a DPS pulls aggro
expectations.tip: Essence of the Red feeds the DPS and a Burning Adrenaline doubles them. Step in the moment he turns.

expectations.label: His head stays on the west wall
expectations.tip: One breath on the raid wipes half of it. Hold his head to the wall and let the tank line be the only people in front.

expectations.label: Run Burning Adrenaline away from the caster pile
expectations.tip: Run the bomb out of your cluster immediately, keep casting instants on the way, and go off alone.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Nobody stands behind him
expectations.tip: Tail Sweep is a 30 yard cone behind him with a huge throw. Stay on the side between front and hind legs.

expectations.label: Stay out of the breath
expectations.tip: Nobody but the current tank ever stands in front of him.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: A breath lands every 4 to 8 seconds, and each one needs a heal landing behind it. There is no mana to save; heal the whole time.

expectations.label: Run Burning Adrenaline away from the other healers
expectations.tip: If it lands on you, go off alone and keep spamming instant heals on the tank on the way.

threatLostCount.label: Times he turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had him
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled him before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

outOfRange.label: Seconds out of range
outOfRange.tip: Carrying a Burning Adrenaline out of the raid is the right kind of out of range. Standing around out of range is not.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

playerInFront.label: Standing in his front
playerInFront.tip: Only the current tank belongs in front of him. Melee stay on the side between front and hind legs.

bombsInRaid.label: Burning Adrenaline detonations in the raid
bombsInRaid.tip: Run it out of the raid, away from everyone, and let it go off with nobody inside 10 yards.

breathsTaken.label: Breaths taken
breathsTaken.tip: Only the tank belongs in front. A bomb carrier running out must not run through his front arc.

tailsTaken.label: Tail Sweeps taken
tailsTaken.tip: Do not stand behind him, and do not carry a bomb through the area behind him.

playerInTail.label: Seconds behind him
playerInTail.tip: The rear cone throws you across the room. Stay on the side.

cues.notes: Press notes: Step in on the tank swap and when a DPS pulls him off; Heal behind every breath. Burning Adrenaline is about your feet, not a button.

list.label: Step in on the tank swap
list.tip: The old tank has dropped. Next tank, take him now.

list.label: Take him back when he turns
list.tip: A DPS has overtaken you. Step in now.

list.label: Heal behind the breath
list.tip: Have a big heal landing right after Flame Breath hits. The burn is still ticking.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a breath coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

drills.name: Tank queue
drills.description: Already on him. Burning Adrenaline on the tank: he stays on them for 18 s, then the old tank dies and he turns. Step in on every swap and keep his head at the wall through the breaths.

drills.name: Burning Adrenaline run-out
drills.description: Every Burning Adrenaline lands on you. Run it out of the raid, let it go off, get back to your spot.

drills.name: Healing the breaths
drills.description: Already on him. A breath every 5 s and Fire Nova every 5 s: heal behind every breath and keep the tank above half.

limitations: Burning Adrenaline does not drain maximum health and kill its target. Tank succession is scripted.
